div.span: Static in-URL HTML • LZ safe encoding

div.label: Encoded URL (site#payload)
div.div: Click Generate to create a shareable link…

div.br: Content is LZ-compressed then URL-safe encoded and placed after the first #. Anything after that first hash is treated as payload — extra ?, # or / never break it. On load the page decompresses → creates a Blob of the chosen MIME → location.replace(blobUrl).
